  Keyboard shortcuts

  Navigate                               Config                                 Queue
  ↑/↓ · j/k  Move                        ↑/↓ · j/k  Move between settings       /      Filter queue
  pgup/pgdn  Page                        enter      Change the selected sett…   o      Sort queue
  home/end   Top / bottom                                                       enter  Torrent details
  tab/⇧tab   Switch tabs                                                        space  Mark torrent
  1/2/3/4    Jump to a tab                                                      esc    Clear marks
                                                                                a      Add torrent

  Torrent actions                        Search                                 Dialogs
  s   Start                              /      New search                      tab/⇧tab  Change field
  p   Pause                              p      Choose provider                 enter     Submit
  f   Force start                        s      Sort results                    esc       Cancel
  m   Move                               f      Filter results
  t   Trackers                           enter  Add result
  e   Edit focused / marked              esc    Cancel / clear filter
  x   Remove
  ⇧d  Delete files

  Session
  ctrl+p · :  Command palette
  ?           Keyboard shortcuts
  r           Refresh
  ctrl+c      Cancel search / quit
  q · ctrl+q  Quit
